description: the woman of the reference picture riding: the queen of a night without stars, a young woman with a slim feminine figure, pale skin, very long silver-white hair hanging down her back, a beautiful feminine face in clean profile, eyes glowing violet, a tall crown of black thorns, a black eclipse disk with a thin silver rim close behind the head, black armour with glowing silver-white lines, huge black feathered wings of shadow folded close behind the back, a long black cloak hanging behind from the shoulders, black heeled boots, no daggers and nothing in the hands but the reins; sitting tall and upright astride a saddle that is not drawn, the back straight, not squatting and not crouching, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing right, the head, chest and hips turned fully to the right; both forearms reaching forward, the two hands together in front of the body holding short reins that end just in front of the hands; only the near leg showing and only one foot in the whole picture: the thigh lying forward and level from the hip to the knee, the knee bent at a right angle, the lower leg hanging vertically straight down from the knee, one whole foot at the bottom with the toes pointing right; the folded wings, the cloak and any long hair close behind the back, not spread out; the far leg completely hidden and not drawn at all, no second boot and no second foot; the whole figure from the top of the wings and the crown to the sole of the foot inside the picture with room around it; nothing under the rider; isolated figure on a plain background

references.usage: the character's look: this same woman, her face, silver hair, thorn crown, eclipse halo, black wings, armour, cloak and colours, drawn the same way; not her standing pose and not the two daggers
